sections.title: BRICS 2026: NEW DELHI DECLARATION
sections.subtitle: 18th BRICS Summit | Key Highlights for Competitive Exams
points: Unanimous condemnation of terrorism in all forms, including cross-border terrorism.
Called for comprehensive reform of global governance and stronger voice for Global South.
Endorsed multilateral trade cooperation, energy transition security, and local currency settlements.
Deepened collaborative initiatives in science, AI governance, and resilient global supply chains.

sections.title: BIMSTEC DELHI DECLARATION 2026
sections.subtitle: First BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Conclave & Security Framework

metadata_grid.label: Members (7)
metadata_grid.value: India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand

points: Strengthened counter-terrorism coordination and action against violent extremist syndicates.
Combating transnational organised crime through shared intelligence repositories.
Coordinated interdiction against illicit precursor chemicals and narcotics money laundering.
Comprehensive regional action framework to dismantle human trafficking networks.
sections.side_note: BIMSTEC Convention on Combating International Terrorism, Transnational Organised Crime and Illicit Drug Trafficking has been actively in force since March 2021.

sections.title: e-SHRAM PORTAL COMPLETES 5 YEARS
sections.subtitle: Universal Social Security Infrastructure for India's Unorganised Workforce
points: Aadhaar-seeded centralized registry enabling full portability of social security welfare benefits.
Seamless API integration with PMSYM pension, PMJJBY insurance, and national apprenticeship portals.
e-Shram One-Stop-Solution ecosystem delivers aggregated access to healthcare, skilling, and credit.
Completely free lifelong digital registration across all Common Service Centres (CSCs).
